description: Owner analytics for an embed: one visit in full. Returns the session with the media it opened (time watched, plays, seeks, furthest position, completed), the questions asked in chat, and a paged list of its events in time order, plus how many sessions the same viewer or browser has had on this embed. Use eventsPage and eventsPageSize to read long timelines.

embedId.description: The embed's _id (24 hex characters), as returned by create_embed or check_embed

id.description: The session's _id (24 hex characters) from list_embed_sessions, not its sessionId

name: get_embed_session

data.description: Response payload from the Speak AI API
